modules.M1: Brand and public experience: existing PackJoyU wordmark, verifiable company content, branded JPG/GIF derivatives, homepage media and public pages; sole owner of shared public/admin visual tokens; no admin permissions/shell. No module dependencies.
modules.M2: Product and 3D: large product cards/list/detail, direct model controls, input conflicts, touch/keyboard access, image fallback, product-context inquiry entry. Depends on M1,M4,M5.
modules.M3: Admin access and accounts: login page and admin shell, personal settings, persistent device sessions, verified passwordless authenticator mode, session revocation and separate restricted account recovery. Consumes M1 tokens; depends on M1.
modules.M4: First-party human consultation: necessary visitor conversations, durable messages, offline contact, ADMIN/SALES inbox, replies, unread, memory-only unsent drafts, idempotent retries and actual notification results. Depends on M1,M3,M5; never waits for dashboard.
modules.M5: Consent and analytics ledger: analysis consent, anonymous browser/event IDs, validation/deduplication, site IANA time zone, daily/product aggregation, retention and recomputation boundaries, real visitor and 3D metrics. Depends on M3; never calls M6.
modules.M6: Business/operations dashboard: role-scoped queries and source status for analytics, consultation, interface errors, mail, storage and backups; zero/no data/not connected/failure/stale distinctions. Depends on M1,M3,M4,M5.
modules.M7: Integrated acceptance and delivery: real cross-module visitor/admin/recovery/analytics journeys and delivery evidence; trace reused unpublished draft provenance without redoing the completed S1 recovery/audit or automatically merging those drafts. Depends on M1,M2,M3,M4,M5,M6.
